title: ThinkReset：面向有界上下文长时推理的可学习中间接口构建
summary: ThinkReset提出在有限上下文窗口下，通过显式构建可复用的中间接口（写入与重置）来替代被丢弃的历史，并直接优化重置后的继续求解成功率，解决了长链推理中的冗余累积、上下文溢出和错误锚定问题，以及结果奖励导致的过早猜测。在多个长时推理基准上提升了固定上下文下的成功率。
summary_en: ThinkReset proposes constructing reusable intermediate interfaces via writeback and reset to replace discarded history under bounded contexts, directly optimizing post-reset continuation success. It addresses redundancy, overflow, error anchoring, and premature guessing in long-chain reasoning, improving success rates on benchmarks.
